name: capabilities
description: Calls that reach the network, files, commands, the environment or eval, shown in the code and in Problems, with what they reach (as written, or from a sandboxed background run) and how each is decided: decide them from the lightbulb.

silo.baseline.markdownDescription: Keep `.silo/baseline.json`: what each dependency's own code can do, made as the project opens and synced as its dependencies and your code change. A package's call within it runs; one beyond it is decided by your policy, and what grew beyond it is warned where it is: a new version's on its dependency's line, your code's use on its import. Off, none is made and the policy decides every package's call: you lose tracking how your dependencies change over time, and how your use of them does.
